question: Cultures ke beech saanskritik vicharon ke sthanantaran mein 'stimulus diffusion' aur 'direct borrowing' kaise alag hain?

question: Adolf Bastian ne sabhi manav samajon dwara saajha kiye jaane wale vicharon aur vibhinn cultures ki prakriti ke baare mein kya prastavit kiya?
ground_truth: Adolf Bastian ne 'manavjati ki mansik ekta' ke paksh mein tark diya.Unhone prastavit kiya ki sabhi samaj 'mool vichar' (Elementargedanken) saajha karte hain.Vibhinn cultures, ya 'lok vichar' (Völkergedanken), un mool vicharon ke sthaniya sanshodhan hain.Unka maanna tha ki sabhi samajon ki vaigyanik tulna yeh dikhayegi ki alag-alag vishwadrishtiyan unhi mool tatvon se bani hain.

question: Terror management theory culture aur manushyon ke liye uski bhoomika ke baare mein kya pratipadit karti hai?
ground_truth: Terror management theory culture ko gatividhiyon aur vishwadrishtiyon ki ek shrinkhala ke roop mein dekhti hai.Ye manushyon ko apne aap ko 'arth ki duniya mein mulyavan vyakti[yon]' ke roop mein dekhne ka aadhar deti hain.Ye manushyon ko astitva ke maatra bhautik pehluon se upar uthati hain.Yeh us pashu tuchhta aur mrityu ko nakarti hai jiske prati Homo sapiens tab jaagruk hue jab unhone bada mastishk prapt kiya.

question: Cultural materialism ka saiddhantik drishtikon manav pratikatmak culture ke baare mein kya maanta hai?
ground_truth: Cultural materialism vyapak social sciences mein ek saiddhantik drishtikon hai.Yeh maanta hai ki manav pratikatmak culture manav jeevan ki bhautik paristhitiyon se utpann hota hai.Yeh maanta hai ki culture ka aadhar viksit jaivik pravrittiyon mein paaya jaata hai.

question: Cultural relativism cultures ke mulyankan ke baare mein kya maanta hai, aur kyon?
ground_truth: Cultural relativism cultural anthropology ke bheetar ek vichardhara aur vishleshanatmak drishtikon hai.Yeh maanta hai ki cultures ko aasani se vastunishth roop se rank ya mulyankit nahi kiya ja sakta.Karan yeh hai ki koi bhi mulyankan anivarya roop se kisi diye gaye culture ki mulya pranali ke bheetar sthit hota hai.

question: World Heritage Committee mein kitne states parties hote hain, unhe kaun chunta hai, aur Committee ko salah kaun deta hai?
ground_truth: Committee 21 'states parties' se bani hai.Unhe United Nations General Assembly dwara chuna jaata hai.Committee ko prakritik ya saanskritik itihas, aur shiksha mein visheshagyon ke antarrashtriya panels ki samikshaon dwara salah di jaati hai.

question: Gough Island ko Europe aur North America kshetra mein kyon vargikrit kiya gaya hai, aur World Heritage Committee dwara Russia aur Caucasus states, aur Mexico aur Caribbean ko kaise vargikrit kiya gaya hai?

question: Rein Raud ke 2016 ke drishtikon ne culture ko kaise paribhashit kiya, aur vah drishtikon kaise sanrachit hai?
ground_truth: Rein Raud ka 2016 ka drishtikon culture ko un sansadhanon ke yog ke roop mein paribhashit karta hai jo manushyon ko apni duniya ko samajhne ke liye uplabdh hain.Yeh do-starit hai.Yeh texts (prachalan mein sabhi vastugat arth) aur cultural practices (uddeshyon ke utpadan, prasar ya sancharan se jude sabhi doharaye ja sakne wale karya) ke adhyayan ko jodta hai.Yeh culture ke anthropological aur sociological adhyayan ko textual theory ki parampara se phir se jodta hai.

question: American anthropology kin chaar kshetron mein sangathit hai, jinmein se pratyek culture par shodh mein mahatvapurn bhoomika nibhata hai?

question: Culture ke prabhav par psychological research, jo 1990s mein badhne lagi, ne cultures ke beech bhavna aur prerna mein antar ke baare mein kya paaya?

question: Karl von Habsburg ke anusar, saanskritik sampattiyon ka vinash psychological warfare ka hissa kyon hai, aur yeh kise prabhavit karne ka lakshya rakhta hai?
ground_truth: Karl von Habsburg kehte hain ki saanskritik sampattiyon ka vinash psychological warfare ka hissa hai.Hamle ka lakshya pratidvandvi ki pehchaan hai.Isiliye pratikatmak saanskritik sampattiyan mukhya lakshya ban jaati hain.Yeh saanskritik smriti, badhti saanskritik vividhta aur kisi rajya, kshetra ya nagarpalika ke aarthik aadhar, jaise paryatan, ko bhi prabhavit karne ka lakshya rakhta hai.

question: Asmara ko badhava dene ke kiske prayason ko is udaharan ke roop mein uddhrit kiya jaata hai ki World Heritage listing bids gareeb deshon ko nuksaan pahunchati hain, aur listing bids aur lobbying ke baare mein aur kya kaha gaya hai?
ground_truth: Asmara ko badhava dene ke Eritrea ke prayason ko udaharan ke roop mein uddhrit kiya jaata hai.Site listing bids aksar lambi aur mehngi hoti hain, jo gareeb deshon ko nuksaan ki sthiti mein daalti hain.In puraskaron ke aaspaas ek bada lobbying udyog viksit ho gaya hai.Karan yeh hai ki World Heritage listing paryatan aay ko kaafi badha sakti hai.

question: Ek Marxist drishtikon samaj ke aarthik aadhar aur culture ke beech ke sambandh ka varnan kaise karta hai, aur feminist cultural studies aur baad ke American vikas is drishtikon par kya pratikriya dete hain?
ground_truth: Marxist drishtikon mein, utpadan ki paddhati aur utpadan ke sambandh samaj ka aarthik aadhar banate hain.Yeh aadhar culture jaisi superstructures ke saath lagatar antarkriya karta hai aur unhe prabhavit karta hai.Feminist cultural studies aur baad ke American vikas is drishtikon se doori banate hain.Ve kisi bhi cultural product ke liye sabhi dwara saajha kiye gaye ek hi, prabhutvashali arth ki Marxist dharana ki aalochna karte hain.

question: Tentative List se lekar Committee ke nirnay tak, kisi desh dwara kisi site ko World Heritage listing ke liye vichaar mein lane ki prakriya kya hai?
ground_truth: Ek desh pehle ek Tentative List mein apni mahatvapurn cultural aur natural sites ki pehchaan karta hai.Phir vah us list se sites ko ek Nomination File mein rakh sakta hai.File ka mulyankan International Council on Monuments and Sites aur World Conservation Union dwara kiya jaata hai.Koi desh un sites ko namankit nahi kar sakta jo pehle uski Tentative List mein shaamil nahi ki gayi hon.World Heritage Committee saal mein ek baar yeh tay karne ke liye milti hai ki kaun si namankit sampattiyan list mein jodi jayein.

question: Danger list par har site ki sanrakshan sthiti ki samiksha kitni baar hoti hai, aur uske baad World Heritage Committee kya kadam utha sakti hai?
ground_truth: Danger list par har site ki sanrakshan sthiti ki har saal samiksha hoti hai.Phir Committee atirikt upayon ka anurodh kar sakti hai.Agar khatre samapt ho gaye hain to vah sampatti ko danger list se hata sakti hai.Agar site ki akhandta ab maujood nahi hai ya vah sthaniya suraksha se bahar ho gayi hai, to vah use World Heritage List se poori tarah hatane par vichar kar sakti hai.

question: Amazon rainforest kya hai, Amazon basin kitna bada hai, iska kitna hissa rainforest se dhaka hai, aur is kshetra mein kitne rashtron ka kshetra hai?

question: Sahara kya hai, yeh kitna bada hai, aur duniya ke registanon mein iska sthan kya hai?

question: Ernest Rutherford ne apne agraani scattering prayog kis vishwavidyalaya mein kiye, aur wahan unhone kya khoja?

question: Milesian school ki sthapna kisne ki, ise kisne aage badhaya, aur ve sabse pehle kya karne ka prayas karne wale the?

question: Scientific method kya hai, aur ismein aam taur par kya shaamil hota hai?

question: Ek theory apne dwara varnit avlokanon ke daayre mein ek hypothesis se kaise alag hai?
ground_truth: Ek theory ek hypothesis ki tulna mein avlokanon ke kahin adhik vyapak sets ka varnan karti hai. Kai hypotheses ko ek hi theory dwara tarkik roop se joda ja sakta hai. Is prakar ek theory vibhinn anya hypotheses ko samjhane wali ek hypothesis hai.

question: Redox reactions mein, reduction aur oxidation kya hain, aur oxidant aur reductant kya karte hain?
ground_truth: Redox reactions parmanuon ki oxidation avasthaon ko badalti hain. Electrons prapt karna reduction hai aur electrons khona oxidation hai. Ek oxidant kisi anya padarth se electrons hatata hai, jabki ek reductant electrons sthanantarit karta hai aur svayam oxidized hota hai.

question: Molecules ya crystals mein parmanuon ko jode rakhne ke liye kin prakar ke rasayanik bandhon ko soochibaddh kiya gaya hai?

question: 1838 mein ab saarvbhaumik cell vicharon ko badhava dena kisne shuru kiya, aur unhone kin do vicharon ko badhava diya?
ground_truth: Schleiden aur Schwann ne in vicharon ko badhava dena shuru kiya. Unka maanna tha ki jeevon ki mool ikai cell hai. Unka yeh bhi maanna tha ki vyaktigat cells mein jeevan ki sabhi visheshtayein hoti hain.

question: Manav vichhedan par aadharit pehli gyat anatomy textbook kisne taiyaar ki, aur chikitsa shikshakon aur chhatron ne manav shariron ko kholna kahan shuru kiya tha?

question: Kis vidwan ne Book of Healing aur The Canon of Medicine likhi, aur ve kitne samay tak manak chikitsa granthon ke roop mein prayog hui?

question: Biology ke liye kitne maulik vishay kendriya hain, aur ve kaun se hain?
ground_truth: Paanch vishay hain. Ve jeevan ki mool ikai ke roop mein cell, aur vanshagati ke aadhar ke roop mein genes aur aanuvanshikta hain. Inmein jaivik vividhta ke chalak ke roop mein evolution, jeevan prakriyaon ko banaye rakhne ke liye urja roopantaran, aur homeostasis bhi shaamil hain.

question: 1860s tak cell theory mein kitne siddhant samekit kiye gaye, aur ve kya the?
ground_truth: Teen siddhant the. Cell jeevon ki mool ikai hai. Vyaktigat cells mein jeevan ki sabhi visheshtayein hoti hain, aur sabhi cells anya cells ke vibhajan se aati hain.

question: Madhya Yug mein kitni pramukh bhashai sanskritiyon ne classical vidya ko aage badhaya, aur ve kaun si thi?

question: Siddhanta Shiromani ke doosre bhaag mein kitne adhyay hain, aur ve kya shaamil karte hain?

question: Varro ki nau kalaon mein se kitni ne baad mein madhyakaleen schools ki saat liberal arts ko paribhashit kiya, aur unki pehchaan kaise hoti hai?

question: Beddoes, Burdach, Treviranus, aur Lamarck mein se pratyek ne biology shabd ko uske aadhunik arth mein swatantra roop se kin saalon mein prastut kiya?
ground_truth: Thomas Beddoes ne ise 1799 mein prastut kiya. Karl Friedrich Burdach ne ise 1800 mein prastut kiya. Gottfried Reinhold Treviranus aur Jean-Baptiste Lamarck ne ise 1802 mein prastut kiya.

question: Madhyakaleen dhatukarm uplabdhiyon mein uddhrit Cistercian blast furnace kis sthan par thi?

question: Deep homology kya hai, kaun se ang iska udaharan dete hain, aur niyantrak genes kahan se aate hain?
ground_truth: Deep homology yeh khoj hai ki asmaan ang, jinhe lambe samay tak alag-alag viksit hua maana gaya, samaan genes dwara niyantrit hote hain. Udaharan keedon, kasherukiyon aur cephalopod molluscs ki aankhein hain. Ye genes evo-devo gene toolkit se aate hain.

question: Conservation biology kiska adhyayan karti hai, aur iska lakshya kis cheez se suraksha karna hai?
ground_truth: Conservation biology Prithvi ki jaivavividhta ke sanrakshan ka adhyayan hai. Iska lakshya prajatiyon, unke aavason, aur ecosystems ki raksha karna hai. Yeh unhe vilupti ki atyadhik daron aur jaivik antarkriyaon ke kshaya se bachati hai.

question: Madrasa ke chhatra kaise seekhte the, aur Ijazah kya tha?

question: Classical genetics kiska adhyayan karti hai, aur iske siddhanton ko kya kaha jaata hai?

question: 628 mein Brahmagupta ne gurutvakarshan ke baare mein kya sujhav diya, aur unhone shoonya aur Hindu-Arabic ank pranali ke baare mein kya samjhaya?

question: Navya-Nyaya ne sabhi Nyaya avdharnaon ko kitni mukhya shreniyon mein vyavasthit kiya, aur ve kaun si hain?
ground_truth: Navya-Nyaya ne sabhi Nyaya avdharnaon ko chaar mukhya shreniyon mein vyavasthit kiya.Pehli indriya ya bodh (pratyaksa) hai.Doosri anumiti (anumana) hai.Teesri tulna ya samanta (upamana) hai.Chauthi saakshya (dhwani ya shabd; sabda) hai.

question: Bakhshali pandulipi kin vishayon ko shaamil karti hai, kis degree ke indeterminate equations sahit?
ground_truth: Bakhshali pandulipi mein ankganit, beejganit aur geometry, jismein mensuration bhi shaamil hai, se jude prashn hain.Iske vishayon mein bhinn, vargmool, aur samantar aur gunottar shreniyan shaamil hain.Yeh saral samikaranon aur yugpat rekhik samikaranon ke hal ko shaamil karti hai.Ismein dvighaat samikaran aur second degree ke indeterminate equations bhi shaamil hain.

question: Tatva apni prakritik avastha mein kis kram mein vyavasthit hain, aur Aether ki kya bhoomika hai?
ground_truth: Apni prakritik avastha mein, prithvi Earth ke sabse nikat hai, uske baad jal, vaayu, agni, aur ant mein Aether.Jal prithvi ke upar, vaayu jal ke upar, aur agni vaayu ke upar hai.Aether ek khagoliya tatva tha aur khagoliya pindon ka padarth banata tha.

question: Ibn al-Haytham ne kya sanshleshit kiya, ise kahan prastut kiya gaya, aur Europe mein is par kitne samay tak bharosa kiya gaya?

question: Pan American Health Organization ka mukhyalay kis shahar mein sthit hai, aur kshetriya sarvajanik swasthya mein iski dohri sangathanatmak bhoomika kya hai?
ground_truth: Pan American Health Organization apna kendriya karyalay Washington, D.C. se sanchalit karta hai. Yeh World Health Organization dhaanche ke antargat Americas ke liye samarpit kshetriya swasthya shakha ke roop mein karya karta hai.

question: Gerhard Domagk ne 1932 mein Germany mein Prontosil par kaun se prayog kiye, aur synthetic antibacterials ke sambandh mein kaun si pramukh khoj hui?
ground_truth: Gerhard Domagk ne 1932 mein Germany mein synthetic dye Prontosil ki antibacterial gatividhi ki khoj ki. Unke prayogshala pareekshanon ne siddh kiya ki sulfonamides jeevit pashu mezbaanon ke andar bacteria ko chayanatmak roop se maar sakte hain.

question: Office International d'Hygiène Publique ki sthapna kahan aur kab hui, aur World Health Organization se pehle isne kya karya kiya?
ground_truth: 1907 mein Paris mein sthapit, Office International d'Hygiène Publique ne vaishvik mahamari rog prakopon ki nigrani ki. Iske swasthya nigrani tantron ko baad mein World Health Organization ke nirmaan par usmein shaamil kar liya gaya.
